kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Manufacturer-identified finished assemblies for this application.
intro.zh: 此应用范围内经原厂资料核验的成品组件。

intro.en: Category-specific material references; the final BOM follows the approved configuration.
intro.zh: 此类选型的材料参考；最终 BOM 以确认配置为准。

copy.en: Single-cable, bunched-cable, fire-resistance, smoke and halogen tests answer different questions.
copy.zh: 单根、成束、耐火、烟密度与无卤试验回答不同问题。

copy.en: Provide exact fire-test method, installation, construction, marking and evidence.
copy.zh: 请提供准确燃烧试验方法、安装、结构、印字与证据。

copy.en: Release records the exact cable identity and supporting fire-test evidence.
copy.zh: 放行记录包含准确线缆身份与支持燃烧试验证据。

copy.en: Confirm the exact mating interface, pin map, dimensions and installation orientation.
copy.zh: 确认准确对插接口、针脚对应、尺寸及安装方向。

copy.en: Agree the sample configuration and electrical, mechanical or environmental checks required by the project.
copy.zh: 约定样品配置以及项目所需的电气、机械或环境检查。

copy.en: Record changes to materials, drawings and process instructions before repeat manufacture.
copy.zh: 重复制造前记录材料、图纸与工艺说明的变更。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: Wire, bulk cable and polymer grades are materials. They are not counted as terminated cable assemblies.
reason.zh: 电线、卷装电缆与胶料牌号属于材料，不计为已端接电缆组件。
